name: breadcrumbs
description: KOZMOS Breadcrumbs: the session's web trail in a sidebar. WebSearch queries with result counts and top hits, WebFetch URLs with status and size, and browser-like MCP visits, grouped by domain with a monogram badge, clickable links and a copy-all-as-Markdown button. /breadcrumbs toggles it.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Breadcrumbs sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
